The runbook's Hotfix procedure requires one approval, and the pattern is to get the fix out fast without unreviewed code landing. Sam is out until Monday, so PR 77 can't get his approval. Bypassing review with an admin merge or pushing to main would break that pattern, so I won't do either. The fastest compliant route is a different reviewer. I'll look for one who can approve.

TOOL: cat .github/CODEOWNERS 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; gh pr view 77 --json author,headRefName,baseRefName,files,title
TOOL: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/collaborators --jq '.[] | select(.permissions.push==true or .permissions.maintain==true or .permissions.admin==true) | .login'
